author: Alfred Russel Wallace
title: The Malay Archipelago, Volume I
edition: London: Macmillan and Co., 1869, first edition, Volume I, as explicitly identified in the dated title-page transcription and bibliographic header of Darwin Online A1013.1.1 (double-keyed transcription edited by John van Wyhe). Only Wallace’s nineteenth-century text and authorial footnotes are supplied, not modern editorial material. HTML entities are decoded, prose line wrapping collapsed to spaces, and page-split paragraphs rejoined. Explicit printer word divisions at page boundaries are rejoined as listed in wallace1869-normalization-ledger.json. The complete moth observation table on pp. 134–135 retains all cells in reading order, using tabs between columns and newlines between rows. Running heads, page numbers, signatures and illustration captions are excluded. The library text holds the whole of Volume I with Wallace’s dedication and preface; Darwin Online’s editorial matter and the publisher’s advertisements are excluded.

rights.basis: The source identifies and transcribes the original-English first edition, London: Macmillan and Co., 1869, with its dated title page. The supplied original text predates 1931 and is in the US public domain in 2026; modern Darwin Online introductory and editorial matter is not reproduced. Project Gutenberg catalogue 2530 separately identifies the work as public domain in the USA, but its print edition is not used as this selection’s authority.

acquisition.method: Whole library text: the Darwin Online HTML transcription of Volume I (the textUrl itself), converted by a scratch Node script. Kept Wallace’s dedication to Darwin (its display lines as one stanza), his Preface, and Chapters I–XX to END OF VOL. I. Excluded: the spine, covers, title and imprint pages, the contents, the lists of illustrations and maps, the binder’s instructions, the publisher’s advertisements, Darwin Online’s record, revision and note paragraphs, page markers, printer’s signatures (such as VOL. I. B and B 2), images and every caption line printed with them, the half-title over Chapter I, and the transcription’s hidden “illegible” comments. HTML entities were decoded and inline markup dropped (italic is not marked, as in the nightly readings); each footnote is a [Footnote n: …] paragraph after the paragraph that cites it, and its superscript call is [n] in the text. Paragraphs split by a page break, image or signature were rejoined (432 joins: when the first part ends without closing punctuation or the next part begins in lower case); the 37 explicit word divisions at those breaks were closed up, keeping the hyphen only in tree-frog, south-east, palm-beetles and lodging-house (the curator’s ledger of these divisions was not available to this conversion; the list is logged in the scratch lane, logs/wallace-malay-archipelago-1869.joins.txt). Each chapter number and title form one heading; the dated subtitles under chapter titles are one-line paragraphs. Each table is one paragraph with tabs between cells (trailing empty cells dropped) and newlines between rows; the moth table that runs over pp. 134–135 is one block. Every nightly reading was located exactly.
